entries.headline: Taiwan CDC adds Novavax public COVID-19 vaccine from October 19, plans more doses
entries.zh: 115年度公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 提醒符合資格民眾儘早接種 還可獲得健康幣 另10月19日起新增提供不同製程之Novavax公費新冠疫苗
entries.why: Public programme (公費): Novavax joins as a second public COVID-19 option, and Taiwan CDC plans additional flu and Novavax doses. Media are framing it as an option for people avoiding mRNA vaccines, and are explaining eligibility.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署10月19日起新增Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗，並規劃增購劑量
entries.why_zh: 公費：Novavax成為第二款公費COVID-19疫苗選項，疾管署並規劃增購流感疫苗及Novavax。媒體將其定位為不願接種mRNA疫苗者的選擇，並說明接種資格。

entries.headline: Joint campaign demand drives top-up purchases; flu doses reported near 3 million
entries.why: Public programme (公費): outlets report extra government purchases, including nearly 500,000 more COVID-19 doses (brand not stated). Flu uptake was reported past 2.26 million, then about 3 million in half a month. Tender and allocation timing becomes the live issue.
entries.headline_zh: 雙苗接種需求帶動追加採購；流感疫苗接種據報近300萬劑
entries.why_zh: 公費：媒體報導政府追加採購，包括再增近50萬劑COVID-19疫苗（未說明廠牌）。流感疫苗接種據報突破226萬劑，半個月內達約300萬劑。招標與配送時程成為焦點議題。

entries.headline: Record flu severity coverage: 144 severe cases, 46 deaths weekly; shortage fears reported
entries.why: The outbreak framing is sustaining demand, and one outlet reports people rushing to vaccinate over shortage fears. These items do not say whether this concerns public or self-pay supply.
entries.headline_zh: 流感重症報導創新高：單週144例重症、46例死亡；傳出缺苗疑慮
entries.why_zh: 疫情框架持續推升需求，一家媒體報導民眾因擔心缺苗而搶打。相關報導未說明涉及公費或自費供應。

entries.headline: Doctors link flu to stroke and cardiovascular risk, urging enhanced vaccines for elders
entries.why: Clinician-led coverage names adjuvanted and high-dose options for older adults, but the funding route is not stated. Overall enhanced-flu volume fell week on week (25 vs 45).
entries.headline_zh: 醫師指流感與中風及心血管風險相關，呼籲長者接種加強型疫苗
entries.why_zh: 以臨床醫師為主的報導提及適合長者的佐劑型與高劑量疫苗，但未說明經費來源。加強型流感疫苗整體聲量較上週下滑（25則對45則）。

entries.headline: Rotary club calls for subsidies as self-pay vaccine costs burden vulnerable elders
entries.why: Self-pay market (自費): a civil-society voice is putting the price of out-of-pocket vaccination on the agenda. This could feed eligibility-expansion arguments for the public programme.
entries.headline_zh: 扶輪社呼籲補助，指自費疫苗費用造成弱勢長者負擔
entries.why_zh: 自費市場：民間團體將自費接種的價格問題推上議程，可能為擴大公費接種資格的論述提供依據。

entries.headline: COVID-19 misinformation recirculates: retracted autopsy claim, viral 'clean lungs' anecdote
entries.why: Fact-checkers rated the 74% autopsy claim false, yet a Threads anecdote implying unvaccinated people are healthier drew high engagement. Posts are signals only, but this is the noise around the Novavax launch.
entries.headline_zh: COVID-19不實訊息再度流傳：已撤稿的解剖研究說法、「肺部乾淨」軼聞爆紅
entries.why_zh: 事實查核單位判定74%解剖研究說法為錯誤，但一則暗示未接種者較健康的Threads軼聞獲得高互動。貼文僅為訊號，但這正是Novavax上路前後的雜音。

watch.text: Novavax public COVID-19 vaccine becomes available: watch for clinic availability reports, eligibility questions and early social reactions.
watch.text_zh: Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗開打：留意診所供應情形、資格疑問及早期社群反應。

watch.text: Second stage of public flu vaccination opens: watch whether top-up doses cover the wider eligible groups and whether shortage fears resurface.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打：留意追加劑量能否涵蓋更廣的適用對象，以及缺苗疑慮是否再起。

watch.text: Follow-up on the infant cluster infection at a Changhua Christian Hospital postpartum care centre (tagged RSV), amid rising RSV conversation (29 vs 18 items).
watch.text_zh: 追蹤彰化基督教醫院產後護理之家嬰兒群聚感染（標記為RSV）後續，RSV討論聲量上升（29則對18則）。

qa.q: Is public programme supply keeping up with demand?
qa.a: Taiwan CDC says it plans additional flu and Novavax doses, and media report top-up purchases, including nearly 500,000 more COVID-19 doses (brand not stated). One outlet reports shortage fears and a rush to vaccinate, but no official shortage notice appears.
qa.q_zh: 公費疫苗供應能否跟上需求？
qa.a_zh: 疾管署表示規劃增購流感疫苗及Novavax，媒體報導追加採購，包括再增近50萬劑COVID-19疫苗（未說明廠牌）。一家媒體報導缺苗疑慮與搶打情形，但未見官方缺苗公告。

qa.q: How visible are enhanced flu vaccines this week?
qa.a: Several clinician-led articles name adjuvanted and high-dose options for older adults and people with chronic illness, mostly without stating the funding route. Enhanced-flu volume fell to 25 items from 45, and a Hsinchu veterans home item mentions enhanced vaccine within the joint campaign at 84% uptake.
qa.q_zh: 本週加強型流感疫苗能見度如何？
qa.a_zh: 數篇以臨床醫師為主的文章提及適合長者與慢性病患者的佐劑型與高劑量疫苗，多數未說明經費來源。加強型流感疫苗聲量由45則降至25則，另有一則新竹榮譽國民之家報導提及雙苗接種中的加強型疫苗，接種率達84%。

qa.q: What safety or misinformation issues could affect the COVID-19 launch?
qa.a: A retracted autopsy study claim is recirculating and has been rated false by fact-checkers. A Threads anecdote implying unvaccinated people are healthier drew about 8,500 engagements. One media piece claiming next-generation COVID-19 vaccine side effects are 'halved' was flagged as misleading, so overstatement in both directions is a risk.
qa.q_zh: 哪些安全性或不實訊息議題可能影響COVID-19疫苗開打？
qa.a_zh: 一項已撤稿的解剖研究說法再度流傳，已遭事實查核單位判定為錯誤。一則暗示未接種者較健康的Threads軼聞獲得約8,500次互動。另有一篇媒體報導稱新一代COVID-19疫苗副作用「減半」，被標記為誤導，顯示正反兩面的誇大說法皆具風險。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: Confirms higher public flu and COVID-19 uptake than last year and urges high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel, setting the strong-demand narrative that preceded the top-up orders.
policy_notes.why_zh: 確認公費流感及COVID-19疫苗接種量高於去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種，奠定追加採購前的需求強勁敘事。

policy_notes.why: Adds Novavax as a second public COVID-19 vaccine from October 19 and signals extra flu and Novavax procurement, which reshapes public-programme supply and brand choice.
policy_notes.why_zh: 10月19日起新增Novavax為第二款公費COVID-19疫苗，並釋出增購流感疫苗及Novavax的訊號，改變公費供應與廠牌選擇格局。

misinfo.claim: A US autopsy study proved 74% of deaths were caused by COVID-19 vaccines
misinfo.note: Already rated false by fact-checkers (paper retracted); keep fact-check links and evidence summaries ready for health-professional and media enquiries rather than amplifying the claim.
misinfo.claim_zh: 美國解剖研究證實74%死亡由COVID-19疫苗造成
misinfo.note_zh: 已遭事實查核單位判定為錯誤（論文已撤稿）；備妥查核連結與證據摘要以回應醫療專業人員及媒體詢問，避免擴大傳播該說法。

misinfo.claim: Anecdote that an unvaccinated mother's unusually clean lung CT shows skipping COVID-19 vaccination is healthier
misinfo.note: High-engagement post; monitor spread around the Novavax launch and brief medical-society contacts so clinicians can address patient questions.
misinfo.claim_zh: 軼聞稱未接種的母親肺部CT異常乾淨，顯示不打COVID-19疫苗較健康
misinfo.note_zh: 高互動貼文；監測其在Novavax開打前後的擴散，並向醫學會聯絡人簡報，協助臨床醫師回應病人疑問。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccination makes no difference to infection or transmission, so vaccinated equals unvaccinated
misinfo.note: Low engagement; track for recurrence, and rely on Taiwan CDC and expert Q&A content already in circulation.
misinfo.claim_zh: 接種COVID-19疫苗對感染或傳播毫無差異，打與不打都一樣
misinfo.note_zh: 互動低；追蹤是否再現，並運用疾管署及專家既有的Q&A內容回應。

misinfo.claim: Australians are sick, maimed or dead from COVID-19 vaccines, causing a skills shortage
misinfo.note: Foreign-origin claim with minimal engagement; no response needed beyond monitoring.
misinfo.claim_zh: 澳洲人因COVID-19疫苗生病、傷殘或死亡，導致技術人力短缺
misinfo.note_zh: 源自國外的說法，互動極少；僅需持續監測。

misinfo.claim: Side effects of next-generation COVID-19 vaccines have been halved
misinfo.note: Pro-vaccine overstatement in media; ensure any company or partner materials stick to approved safety data to avoid credibility backlash.
misinfo.claim_zh: 新一代COVID-19疫苗副作用已減半
misinfo.note_zh: 媒體出現支持疫苗的誇大說法；確保公司或合作夥伴資料均依核准的安全性數據，以免引發公信力反彈。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: No item names nirsevimab or Beyfortus this week. RSV volume rose (29 vs 18 items), driven by a reported cluster of 16 infant infections within 20 days at a postpartum care centre linked to Changhua Christian Hospital. A single parent post reports paying out of pocket for a maternal RSV shot.
products.implication: Infant RSV protection is entering public conversation through outbreak news rather than product coverage, so questions from media, care centres and parents about infant options and cost may reach the company without a policy hook.
products.action: Prepare a factual issue-readiness pack on infant RSV burden and the regulatory and funding status of infant protection in Taiwan, and brief medical affairs on handling inbound questions from care centres and health bureaus without product promotion.
who: Postpartum care centre operators and associations
products.signal_zh: 本週無任何報導提及nirsevimab或Beyfortus。RSV聲量上升（29則對18則），主因是彰化基督教醫院相關產後護理之家傳出20天內16名嬰兒群聚感染。另有一則家長貼文表示自費接種孕婦RSV疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV保護是透過疫情新聞而非產品報導進入公共討論，因此媒體、產後護理之家及家長可能在缺乏政策切入點的情況下，向公司詢問嬰兒保護選項與費用。
products.action_zh: 準備嬰兒RSV疾病負擔及台灣嬰兒保護法規與經費現況的事實型議題應對資料包，並向醫學事務部門簡報，在不涉及產品推廣下回應產後護理之家與衛生局的詢問。
who_zh: 產後護理之家業者及公會

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: Doctors quoted by Rti, Life and 健康醫療網 link flu in older adults to stroke, disability and cardiovascular risk and mention adjuvanted or high-dose options. A veterans home in Hsinchu reports 84% uptake under the joint campaign with enhanced vaccine mentioned. High-dose volume eased to 11 items from 16.
products.implication: Clinician-led coverage keeps the enhanced category visible beyond long-term care, but funding is rarely stated, which can blur public eligibility and self-pay availability and create expectations among older adults outside facilities.
products.action: Prepare evidence summaries on flu burden in older adults for health bureaus and geriatric societies, track how enhanced-vaccine eligibility is described in coverage, and keep company-linked commentary strictly non-promotional given Taiwan's advertising rules.
who: Taiwan Association of Gerontology and Geriatrics

products.implication_zh: 以臨床醫師為主的報導使加強型疫苗在長照機構以外持續曝光，但鮮少說明經費來源，可能混淆公費資格與自費供應，並使機構外長者產生期待。
products.action_zh: 為衛生局及老年醫學會準備長者流感疾病負擔的證據摘要，追蹤報導如何描述加強型疫苗接種資格，並鑑於台灣廣告法規，確保公司相關評論嚴守非推廣原則。

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adults and pregnancy
products.signal: Very little this week: Tdap appeared in 7 items (5 the week before), and no recent coverage or social post discusses pertussis or Tdap specifically.
products.implication: There is no live issue to manage; Tdap is absent from the respiratory-season conversation dominated by flu and COVID-19.
products.action: Keep background monitoring and hold existing evidence materials on maternal and adult pertussis ready in case RSV or infant-protection stories widen to other maternal vaccines.
products.sub_zh: 成人及孕婦百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週極少：Tdap出現於7則（前一週5則），近期無報導或社群貼文專門討論百日咳或Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 目前無需處理的議題；在流感與COVID-19主導的呼吸道季節討論中，Tdap未被提及。
products.action_zh: 維持背景監測，並備妥孕婦及成人百日咳既有證據資料，以防RSV或嬰兒保護報導延伸至其他孕婦疫苗。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced on October 13 that publicly funded Novavax will be offered from October 19 and that additional Novavax doses are planned. Multiple outlets carried the date, and Yahoo and LINE TODAY ran explainers on public eligibility for the rollout starting next week.
products.implication: The launch is official and widely covered, so first-week availability at clinics, eligibility clarity and any early experience reports will shape public perception of the brand within days.
products.action: Coordinate with Taiwan CDC on supply and site readiness for October 19, prepare factual Q&A on eligibility and supply for media and health bureau enquiries, and set up close monitoring of post-launch social reports and safety questions.
products.signal_zh: 疾管署10月13日宣布公費Novavax將於10月19日起提供，並規劃增購Novavax。多家媒體報導此日期，Yahoo及LINE TODAY並刊出下週開打的公費接種資格說明。
products.implication_zh: 開打已正式宣布且廣受報導，首週診所供應情形、資格說明是否清楚及早期接種經驗分享，將在數日內形塑民眾對品牌的觀感。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署協調10月19日的供應及接種站準備，針對媒體與衛生局詢問準備資格與供應的事實型Q&A，並密切監測開打後的社群回報與安全性疑問。

issues.title: Novavax public rollout first week: site availability and eligibility questions
issues.note: The CDC date is fixed and widely reported; gaps between announced availability and clinic stock, or confusion over eligibility, would surface quickly in media and posts.
issues.title_zh: Novavax公費開打首週：接種點供應與資格疑問
issues.note_zh: 疾管署日期已定且廣受報導；若公告供應與診所庫存有落差，或資格出現混淆，將迅速反映在媒體與貼文中。

issues.title: Second-stage public flu opening tests supply amid shortage fears
issues.note: Media already report people rushing over shortage fears while CDC orders more doses; a wider eligible pool could renew supply and enhanced-vaccine access questions.
issues.title_zh: 公費流感第二階段開打，在缺苗疑慮下考驗供應
issues.note_zh: 媒體已報導民眾因擔心缺苗而搶打，疾管署則追加採購；適用對象擴大可能再度引發供應及加強型疫苗取得問題。

issues.title: Infant RSV cluster coverage prompts questions on infant protection and cost
issues.note: The postpartum care centre cluster and parent posts on self-paid RSV shots could draw calls for public funding or care-centre requirements.
issues.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV群聚報導引發嬰兒保護與費用疑問
issues.note_zh: 產後護理之家群聚事件及家長自費RSV疫苗貼文，可能引發公費補助或產後護理之家規範的呼聲。

self_pay.title: Self-pay cost burden for older adults outside eligibility
self_pay.note: A Rotary club, reported by 自由時報 and LINE TODAY, calls for subsidies because self-paid vaccination weighs heavily on vulnerable older adults; this frames price as an access issue rather than a market one.
self_pay.title_zh: 不符資格長者的自費負擔
self_pay.note_zh: 自由時報及LINE TODAY報導，扶輪社因自費接種對弱勢長者造成沉重負擔而呼籲補助；此將價格定位為可近性議題而非市場議題。

self_pay.title: Maternal RSV paid out of pocket
self_pay.note: One pregnant poster reports paying for an RSV shot and being told the price would be higher after birth; this is a thin signal, and no item mentions self-pay infant antibodies.
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦發文表示自費接種RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會更高；此為微弱訊號，且無任何報導提及自費嬰兒抗體。

self_pay.title: Enhanced flu: clinician interest, no stock or price data
self_pay.note: Doctors in the media discuss adjuvanted and high-dose options for older adults without stating funding, but no item covers clinic stock, prices or self-pay demand for enhanced vaccines or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感疫苗：臨床醫師關注，但無庫存或價格資料
self_pay.note_zh: 媒體上的醫師討論適合長者的佐劑型與高劑量選項但未說明經費，且無任何報導涉及加強型疫苗或Tdap的診所庫存、價格或自費需求。

self_pay.title: Shortage fears may spill into private demand
self_pay.note: A news report describes people worried about shortages and rushing to vaccinate, without saying whether this affects self-pay clinic stock.
self_pay.title_zh: 缺苗疑慮可能外溢至自費需求
self_pay.note_zh: 一則新聞描述民眾擔心缺苗而搶打，但未說明是否影響自費診所庫存。
